tools.name: top_markets
tools.description: Which US rental markets look strongest right now? National (or single-state) leaderboard: zips with the highest estimated cap-rate bands among markets with population of 10,000+ and complete rent, vacancy, and home-value data. Cap rates are a modeled band.

tools.name: compare_zips
tools.description: How do these zip codes compare as rental markets? Side-by-side comparison of 2-6 US zips: rent, cap-rate band (modeled), vacancy, home value, population, renter share, income, employment, with a doorbase.app link for each.

tools.name: hazard_risk
tools.description: What flood, wildfire, and wind risk does this zip code carry? NFIP flood-insurance claims on record (count, payouts, recency, claims per 1,000 housing units), FEMA National Risk Index county scores for flood, wildfire, and wind, and recent significant storm events. Claims are history, not a forecast

tools.name: rent_trend
tools.description: Which way is rent moving in this zip code? Monthly median-rent history with home values, the direction of movement, and the zip's national and state rank for 3-month rent growth. Updated monthly.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_zip_market · Private data: hazard_risk · Public sink: search_markets, compare_zips.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_zip_market · Private data: hazard_risk · Public sink: search_markets, compare_zips

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_zip_market" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "What does the rental market look like in this zip code? findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
